title: Plan a Playdate
learning_objectives: Plan activities together with a friend

events.description: Your friend Alex is coming over for 3 hours! You want to play video games but Alex wants to play outside. How do you figure it out?

choices.label: Do both — 1.5 hours each!
choices.effect: Great compromise! You both get to do what you love!

choices.label: Let Alex pick since they're the guest
choices.effect: What a thoughtful host! Alex feels so welcome!

choices.label: Think of something you both like
choices.effect: You came up with a board game you both love! Creative problem solving!

events.description: You're having a great time! But Alex accidentally knocks over your favorite building block tower. What do you do?

choices.label: Say 'It's okay, accidents happen!'
choices.effect: Alex feels better right away. You can rebuild it together!

choices.label: Ask Alex to help rebuild it
choices.effect: Building it together makes it even better than before!

choices.label: Take a deep breath, then decide
choices.effect: Taking a moment to calm down is really mature! Then you figured out what to do next.

events.description: It's snack time! You have two choices in the kitchen. Alex has a food allergy and one option might not work for them.

choices.label: Ask Alex what they can eat
choices.effect: Asking first is so considerate! Alex tells you what works and you both enjoy a snack!

choices.label: Pick the option that works for everyone
choices.effect: You picked the safe choice! Being thoughtful about friends' needs is really kind!

recap_template: You planned a great playdate! You practiced compromising, handling accidents calmly, and being thoughtful about your friend's needs.
positive_framing_rules: Never frame disagreements as fights or conflicts
Model kindness and consideration in all options
ai_variation_allowed: Change the friend's name and preferences
Add a surprise fun moment during the playdate

title: Team Decision
learning_objectives: Find fair solutions when people disagree

events.description: Your class team needs to pick a project topic. Sam wants animals, Jordan wants space, and Taylor wants dinosaurs. You're the tiebreaker! How do you decide?

choices.label: Take a vote — everyone picks!
choices.effect: A fair vote! The team agrees to go with the winner. Democracy in action!

choices.label: Combine ideas — animals in space!
choices.effect: Creative! The team loves the mash-up idea! Everyone's idea is included!

choices.label: Discuss why each person likes their topic
choices.effect: Great listening! After hearing reasons, the team finds an idea everyone's excited about!

events.description: The team is working on the project. One person is doing more work than others. What do you suggest?

choices.label: Split the work into equal parts
choices.effect: Everyone has a clear job now! The workload is fair and balanced!

choices.label: Ask if anyone needs help
choices.effect: Turns out someone was stuck! Now that they have help, everyone's contributing!

choices.label: Let people do what they're best at
choices.effect: Sam draws, Jordan writes, Taylor researches, and you organize! Everyone shines!

events.description: Presentation day! The team is nervous. How do you help everyone feel ready?

choices.label: Practice together one more time
choices.effect: Practice makes confident! The whole team feels ready!

choices.label: Tell everyone they did great work
choices.effect: Your encouragement boosts everyone's confidence! Team spirit!

recap_template: You helped your team make decisions, share work fairly, and support each other. Those are amazing teamwork skills!
positive_framing_rules: Never label any team member as lazy or unhelpful
Celebrate all approaches to group work
Frame disagreements as opportunities to find better solutions
ai_variation_allowed: Add a surprise challenge during the project

title: Goal Tracker
learning_objectives: Check in on progress each day
Learn that setbacks are part of the process

events.description: Let's set a goal for this week! What would you like to work on?

choices.label: Read for 20 minutes every day
choices.effect: Great goal! Reading every day builds your imagination and vocabulary!

choices.label: Do one kind thing every day
choices.effect: A kindness goal! The world could use more kindness. Love it!

choices.label: Play outside for 30 minutes daily
choices.effect: Active goal! Moving your body gives you energy and makes you feel great!

events.description: Day 3! You've been doing great, but today was really busy and you almost forgot about your goal. What do you do?

choices.label: Do it even though you're tired
choices.effect: You pushed through! Even a little bit of effort counts!

choices.label: Do a smaller version today
choices.effect: 10 minutes instead of 20 still counts! Adjusting your plan is smart!

choices.label: Skip today, do extra tomorrow
choices.effect: One day off is totally fine! You can catch up tomorrow!

events.description: It's Day 5 — the last day of your goal week! How do you feel about what you accomplished?

choices.label: Celebrate! I did my best!
choices.effect: You should be so proud! Sticking with a goal for a whole week is amazing!

choices.label: Set an even bigger goal for next week!
choices.effect: Level up! Your confidence is growing along with your skills!

recap_template: You set a goal and tracked it for a whole week! You learned that goals take daily effort, and it's okay to adjust along the way.
positive_framing_rules: Never say the student gave up or quit
Frame missed days as normal and recoverable
Celebrate effort and persistence, not perfection
ai_variation_allowed: Add surprise challenges or motivating moments
